items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Joe Morazz calls me, we the people.

ctx.x: But we can get a little bit of it in anyway. I didn't think we'd get this far, man.
What does Joe Morazz call me, honey? I made him mad one night up at the jazz club. You know I call you. Joe Morazz calls me, we the people. We the people.
